log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Do all quick kills in the AFTERNOON, which rules out only day workers (pool about 55%). Never kill in the morning, evening or night. National victims are safe, so always kill them. L ignores a place until 3 of its victims are traced successfully. Then each traced victim from that place cuts the pool to about 25% (hospital 20%). The pool must stay above 1000, so at most 2 kinds of place should get revealed. Two kinds are unreachable, and kills from those are free. Find them using the deaths_traced count. Day 1 probe: killed national + 2 forum + 2 foreign (5 deaths, all traced). The increase in deaths_traced = how many of the 4 forum/foreign victims were traced successfully. 0 = forum and foreign both unreachable. 2 = one of them reachable. 4 = both reachable. Next: probe South/hospital/radio the same way, 2 at a time. Then mass-kill from the unreachable kinds to reach 30-40 deaths in 5 days for the multiplier.

STRATEGY: Do all quick kills in the AFTERNOON, which rules out only day workers (pool about 55%). National victims are always safe to kill. L ignores a place until 3 of its victims are traced successfully. Then each traced victim from that place cuts the pool to about 25% (hospital 20%). The pool must stay above 1000. Two kinds are unreachable, and kills from those are free.
DAY 1: killed national + 2 forum + 2 foreign. deaths_traced went 0->2, so most likely exactly one of forum/foreign is reachable (the 2 successful traces both came from it). That place now has 2 traced victims. One more traced victim from it will trigger L, so avoid it.
DAY 2 probe: killed national + 1 forum (d2-3) only, both afternoon. If deaths_traced rises by 1 (2->3), forum is REACHABLE and foreign is free. Forum is now at 3, so L acts and the pool shrinks to about 25%; never kill forum again. If it stays at 2, forum is unreachable (free) and foreign is reachable (at 2 traced); never kill foreign.
NEXT: probe South, hospital and radio one at a time with 1-2 kills each, keeping each reachable place under 3 traced. Then mass-kill (up to 10 quick + 2 timed) from the unreachable kinds to reach 30-40 deaths in 5 days for the multiplier. Watch the pool each day.

STRATEGY: Do all quick kills in the AFTERNOON, which rules out only day workers (pool about 55%). National victims are always safe. L ignores a place until 3 of its victims are traced successfully; after that each further constraint cuts the pool to about 25%. The pool must stay above 1000, so I can afford at most ONE more trigger (13750 -> about 3400). A second would be fatal.
RESULTS: Day 2 pool fell 60k->10k and deaths_traced went 2->3, so FORUM IS REACHABLE and L is acting on it. FOREIGN IS UNREACHABLE: a victim reported in foreign can never be traced, so foreign kills are always free. NEVER kill forum again. True pool is about 13750.
One more unreachable kind remains among regional, sector (hospital) and age (radio).
DAY 3 probe: killed national + 2 foreign + 1 South (d3-3), all afternoon. deaths_traced before was 3. If it becomes 4, South is reachable (1 traced); never let it reach 3. If it stays at 3, South is likely unreachable, though a hidden reachable second report could make the trace fail anyway. Probe again if unsure.
NEXT: probe hospital, then radio, 1 kill per day, tracking each reachable place's traced count (keep each at 2 or less). Once the second unreachable kind is found, mass-kill national + foreign + that kind every day (up to 10 quick + 2 timed) to build toward 30-40 deaths in 5 days for the multiplier.

STRATEGY: Do all quick kills in the AFTERNOON, which rules out only day workers (pool about 55%). National victims are always safe. L ignores a place until 3 of its victims are traced successfully; after that each further constraint cuts the pool to about 25%. True pool is about 13750, so I can afford at most ONE more trigger (to about 3400). A second would be fatal.
RESULTS: FORUM IS REACHABLE (the day 2 trigger), so NEVER kill forum. FOREIGN IS UNREACHABLE: foreign kills are always free.
Day 3: one South kill and deaths_traced stayed at 3, so the South trace failed and South is likely unreachable.
DAY 4 probe: killed national + 2 foreign + 2 South (d4-6, d4-11), all afternoon. deaths_traced before was 3. If it stays at 3, SOUTH IS CONFIRMED UNREACHABLE, and then hospital and radio are both REACHABLE: never kill them. If it rises to 4 or 5, South is reachable with that many traced, so never kill South again (2 is the safe maximum); in that case the unreachable kind is hospital or radio, so probe one of them with 1 to 2 kills.
NEXT, IF SOUTH IS CONFIRMED: every day kill national + all foreign + all South as afternoon quick kills (about 5 a day). Watch for hidden second reports: about 30% of non-national victims are also reported somewhere I don't follow. A victim carried by one of my unreachable outlets can't be traced at all, so these kills are safe. Keep an eye on the pool anyway.

CONFIRMED: South (regional) and FOREIGN are UNREACHABLE. Hospital, radio and forum are REACHABLE. Day 4: 2 South and 2 foreign kills left deaths_traced at 3.
STRATEGY: All quick kills go in the AFTERNOON, which rules out only day workers. The pool is about 13750 and shows as 10000.
SAFE EVERY DAY, kill them all: national, foreign, South. Any victim carried by South or foreign cannot be traced.
FORUM IS SAFE TOO: forum is already triggered, so the pool is already limited to forum readers. A forum-only constraint adds nothing, and 'forum OR X' adds nothing either. The one risk is a hidden hospital or radio report counting toward those triggers.
HOSPITAL and RADIO: neither has triggered yet. Each triggers at 3 successfully traced victims, and after that each pure constraint cuts the pool to about 25% (about 3400), which is survivable ONCE. Budget: day 5 used 1 hospital kill (d5-4) and 1 radio kill (d5-2). From now on, at most 1 more hospital and 1 more radio, ever. Better to stop at that.
WATCH deaths_traced: before day 5 it was 3. Day 5 kills: national, 2 foreign, 2 South, 2 forum, 1 hospital, 1 radio. The forum, hospital and radio victims are traceable (unless they had a hidden South or foreign report), so expect deaths_traced to rise by about 3 to 4.
IF THE POOL DROPS to about 3000, stop all hospital and radio kills, and stop forum kills too if anything looks odd.
The x2 multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days, which is not reachable at about 9 a day, so ignore it.
